description: USB HID activity jiggler for CardputerZero

store.summary: Keeps a connected computer awake by simulating mouse and keyboard activity over USB.
store.description: Jiggler turns CardputerZero into a small USB accessory that keeps a connected computer from going idle or locking. Set the USB switch to Device and plug the right-side USB-C port into a computer (it charges the Cardputer at the same time). Jiggler then sends small, randomized mouse nudges (the pointer moves and returns) and/or Shift taps that type nothing, at an interval you choose - no software to install on the host. Works with Windows and macOS. Everything is controlled from the five keys under the screen: start/stop, cycle between mouse, keyboard, or both, and adjust the interval. While jiggling, the screen turns off after 30 seconds to save power and heat; any key wakes it. The package installs a small boot-time service (cp0-hid-gadget) that sets up the USB keyboard/mouse gadget.
